transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: ConversalQ technical support, how can I help?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I can't log into my account. I get an error saying 'invalid credentials' but I'm sure my password is right.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Let's get this sorted. Can you tell me what browser and operating system you're using?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Okay. First, let's try clearing your browser cache and cookies for our domain, then attempt the login again. Do you know how to do that?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, one second... ok I cleared them. Still same error.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Got it. Can you try opening the site in an incognito window?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Same thing. It says invalid credentials.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Let me check your account on the backend. What's your email address?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I can see your account. It looks like it was flagged by our security system after 5 failed login attempts, possibly from an earlier attempt. I'm unlocking it now.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Oh! I did try a few times before calling. I forgot I changed my password last week.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That explains it. Your account is unlocked. Try logging in now, and use the password you set last week.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: It worked! I'm in. Thank you so much.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great! To prevent this in future, you can use the 'Forgot Password' link to reset if you're ever unsure. Is there anything else I can help with?
